name: Nyuukan Nurse!
source:
Main heroine is a rookie nurse. Her main problem is A cup breast size. One day she confuses orange liquid in the laboratory for juice, and her breast becomes G cup due to excessive development of hormones. That transformation also affects her sensuality.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是一名初入职场的护士，主要烦恼是胸部只有A罩杯。一天，她误把实验室里的橙色液体当成果汁喝下，激素过度分泌令胸部增大到G罩杯。这场变化也影响了她的感官与欲望。
